knowledge.title: Spindle vibration: inspection checklist
knowledge.author: Maya Chen
knowledge.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO SOP · Revision 1

Scope: CNC-01 spindle vibration. This example is for demonstrating SHIFT, not a machine-specific service procedure.

1. Record the symptom, operation, tool identifier, and when the vibration occurs.
2. Before inspection, a qualified technician must follow the site-approved shutdown and lockout/tagout procedure and verify the safe state.
3. Review tooling balance and visible condition using the approved manufacturer procedure.
4. Review lubrication history and reported spindle noise. Bearing wear, lubrication problems, and tool imbalance are hypotheses, not confirmed diagnoses.
5. Escalate unresolved findings to the maintenance supervisor. Only authorized personnel may approve return to service.

No operating limits or repair specifications are provided in this synthetic example.

knowledge.title: Tool imbalance after a changeover
knowledge.author: Arun Patel
knowledge.content:
SYNTHETIC FIELD NOTE

A demonstration case recorded vibration after a tooling changeover. The maintenance team reviewed tooling condition under the approved isolation procedure and referred the tool assembly for a qualified balance inspection.

Outcome: tooling inspection was requested. This historical example does not establish the cause of a new fault.

knowledge.title: Hydraulic pressure: shift inspection
knowledge.author: Leo Martin
knowledge.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO SOP

Record the observed pressure indication and operating context. Report visible leakage or unusual noise to the supervisor. Do not open pressurized components. Inspection and isolation must follow the site-approved procedure.

knowledge.title: Conveyor alignment handover
knowledge.author: Arun Patel
knowledge.content:
SYNTHETIC FIELD NOTE

The outgoing team reported a conveyor alignment concern during handover. A qualified maintenance inspection was scheduled. Record asset identity and observations before escalation; do not adjust moving equipment.

knowledge.content: Synthetic observation: intermittent vibration was noticed during a finishing operation after a tool change. The technician documented the tool identifier and requested maintenance review. Root cause has not been confirmed.
